annotations.title: NWS weather alerts for up to 10 areas

description: NWS weather alerts for up to 10 areas — Active National Weather Service watches, warnings and advisories for up to 10 US states and/or points in one call. Areas are separated by semicolons: a 2-letter state (TN) or name=lat,lon (Denver=39.74,-104.99). Returns per-area alert counts, highest severity and top alerts, plus an overall ALL CLEAR / ADVISORY / WATCH / DANGER status, the worst area and event totals. Pass ?areas=. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_alerts_batch
